title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten distinct study settings in Occidental’s Academic Commons, selected from the library’s current spaces guide.

cards.title: Ahmanson Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Academic Commons • 2nd floor, Hunt Wing
cards.notes: Head to the Hunt Wing’s second floor when you need a named quiet-study room; pair a reading block with nearby library research help.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet-study reading room in the Academic Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental lists the Ahmanson Reading Room, on the second floor of the Hunt Wing, as a quiet study space.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Academic Commons; consult the library’s current visit page for building-access details.

cards.title: Jeffers Room
cards.subtitle: Academic Commons • 2nd floor, Hunt Wing
cards.notes: Use this second-floor Hunt Wing quiet-study room for sustained reading or individual work, then keep group discussion for another space.
cards.short_summary: A named quiet room alongside other Academic Commons study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental lists the Jeffers Room, on the second floor of the Hunt Wing, as a quiet study space.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Academic Commons; consult the library’s current visit page for building-access details.

cards.title: LA Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Academic Commons • 3rd floor, Hunt Wing
cards.notes: Set up in this third-floor Hunt Wing quiet-study room when your task calls for a calmer reading environment away from group rooms.
cards.short_summary: A third-floor reading room designated for quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental lists the LA Reading Room, on the third floor of the Hunt Wing, as a quiet study space.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Academic Commons; consult the library’s current visit page for building-access details.

cards.title: Library Room 101
cards.subtitle: Academic Commons • 1st-floor collaboration space
cards.notes: Bring a small group to this first-floor collaboration room; it is first-come, first-served, and individuals should yield it to groups.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor collaboration room for group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental identifies Library Room 101 as a first-floor collaboration space available first-come, first-served, with priority for groups.
cards.access_notes: First-come, first-served; individuals should give precedence to groups.

cards.evidence_claim: Occidental identifies Library Room 102 as a first-floor collaboration space available first-come, first-served, with priority for groups.

cards.title: Brown Learning Lab
cards.subtitle: Academic Commons • LIB 219, 2nd floor
cards.notes: For a small group, check whether LIB 219 is unbooked; its modular tables, movable chairs, projection, and wall-mounted whiteboards support active work.
cards.short_summary: A multimodal learning room with flexible furniture and whiteboards.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental describes the Brown Learning Lab (LIB 219) as a second-floor multimodal space with modular tables, movable chairs, projection, and multiple wall-mounted whiteboards.
cards.access_notes: Reservations are required for classes, workshops, and special events; small groups may use it without a reservation when it is not booked.
